name: Transit router exactInputV3Swap arbitrary pool call
summary: The Transit router's exactInputV3Swap path treats the caller-supplied pools array as trusted call targets, so the attacker pointed the first hop at its own contract and drained the router's held balances.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
